title: Reign of the Seven Dragon Sovereigns
dateDisplay: Pre-Genesis • Age of the Primordial Realm
summary: Before the arrival of gods or humanity, Teyvat was ruled by seven colossal elemental dragons led by the Dragon King Nibelung.
description: In the ancient world of the Light Realm, the Seven Dragon Sovereigns held total dominion over the pure elemental elements of Teyvat. Under the rule of the Dragon King Nibelung, civilizations of vishaps flourished across the primordial lands before external beings ever pierced through the firmament.

sources.title: Before Sun and Moon
sources.quote: In the beginning, the world was ruled by the dragons. Then came the heavens...

sources.title: Neuvillette - Character Story 5
sources.quote: Severed from the primordial throne, the authority of the dragons was wrested away by the usurper.

title: Arrival of Phanes & The Primordial War
summary: The Primordial One (Phanes) arrives in Teyvat, creates the Four Shades, and wages a forty-year war to subjugate the Seven Dragons.
description: Born from an egg and crowned with wings, the Primordial One arrived from the cosmos. Accompanied by four glowing shades (including the Shade of Time, Istaroth, and the Shade of Death), Phanes waged a colossal war against the Seven Sovereigns for forty years. Defeating the dragons, Phanes established the Heavenly Principles and began terraforming Teyvat for mortal life.

images.caption: Phanes descending from the celestial firmament
images.alt: Celestial golden light bursting through clouds

images.caption: The Forty-Year War that shook heaven and earth
images.alt: Dramatic mountains and cosmic aurora

sources.title: Before Sun and Moon: When the Doves Held Branches
sources.quote: The Primordial One, or Phanes... It had wings and a crown, and was born from an egg, neither male nor female. But if the world would be created, the eggshell had to be broken.

title: The Unified Human Civilization & Divine Envoy Era
dateDisplay: Pre-Archon War • Golden Age of Humanity
summary: Humanity prospers in a single unified civilization under the direct guidance of heavenly Seelie envoys.
description: During humanity's earliest golden epoch, a singular civilization spanned all corners of Teyvat, sharing one language and architecture (seen today in subterranean ruins across all seven nations). Celestia guided mortal kingdoms through beautiful, wise Seelie envoys, and humanity lived in peace with no concept of starvation or territorial borders.

images.caption: Seelie guiding mortals in the age of harmony
images.alt: Ethereal mystical wisps over starry landscape

sources.title: Tiara of Frost / Artifact Circlets
sources.quote: They say that, once upon a time, the people of the land could hear the revelations from the heavens directly. The envoys of the gods walked among beneficial humanity...

title: The Second Who Came & The Sinking of Enkanomiya
eraName: The Second Who Came & War in Heaven
summary: A second extraterrestrial force invades Teyvat, triggering a catastrophic war in heaven that shatters the unified civilization and casts Enkanomiya beneath the waves.
description: The peace of Teyvat was violently shattered when 'The Second Who Came' descended from beyond the sky. A catastrophic war between the invaders and the Primordial One tore the heavens apart. Vast landmasses collapsed into the oceanic abyss; among them was Enkanomiya, plunging thousands of mortals into perpetual darkness beneath the realm of Bathysmal Vishaps.

sources.title: Before Sun and Moon: The Funerary Year
sources.quote: The second throne of the heavens came, and war opened, as did the heavens and the earth. Then, the land of Byakuyakoku was sunk into the waters.

title: Divine Nails Fall: The Ruin of Sal Vindagnyr
eraName: The Second Who Came & War in Heaven
summary: A Celestial Divine Nail strikes Dragonspine, turning the lush mountain kingdom of Sal Vindagnyr into a frozen graveyard.
description: High upon what is now known as Dragonspine once stood Sal Vindagnyr, an idyllic, lush green mountain realm with a sacred silver-white Irminsul tree. Suspected of questioning the heavens, the civilization was devastated when a Celestial Nail plummeted from the sky. The blast shattered the mountain, froze the climate permanently, and doomed Princess and her people to frozen extinction.

sources.quote: When the nail from the heavens broke the mountain into shards, the girl picked a branch from the frost-covered tree...

sources.title: Snow-Tombed Starsilver Weapon Lore
sources.quote: When the heavens' pillars descended, the lush mountain was swallowed by endless howling ice and snow.

title: Guili Assembly & The Passing of Guizhong
summary: Morax and Guizhong co-found the prosperous Guili Assembly in the plains of Liyue, until tragedy strikes during the Archon War.
description: Morax (the God of Geo) and Guizhong (the Goddess of Dust) formed a deep bond of wisdom and strength, uniting their peoples on the plains of Guili. Guizhong created the Guizhong Ballista and sought to teach mortals machinery and virtue. During the peak of the Archon War, dark gods attacked the plains. Guizhong perished in a field of Glaze Lilies, and Morax led the grieving survivors south to found Liyue Harbor.

sources.quote: Guizhong and Morax were allies. They gathered the people upon the plains, giving it the name Guili from their combined names...

sources.quote: She spoke with a gentle smile: 'This is the mark of our pledge, and it is also my challenge to you. All my wisdom is hidden within this stone dumbbell.'

title: The Rebellion of Old Mondstadt & Barbatos' Ascension
summary: Mortals and a humble wind spirit rebel against Decarabian's howling hurricane cage in Old Mondstadt, establishing new freedom.
description: In Old Mondstadt (today's Stormterror's Lair), the God of Storms Decarabian kept his people enclosed in an impenetrable wall of wind, believing he protected them from the biting blizzards of Andrius. A nameless youth, the maiden Amos, and a tiny wind sprite rallied the populace in a desperate rebellion for freedom. Decarabian fell in battle, the boy died in his companion's arms, and the sprite ascended to become Barbatos, reshaping Mondstadt's mountains with gentle breezes.

sources.title: Biography of Gunnhildr
sources.quote: A nameless wind spirit heard the cries of the people... from the songs of the bard arose the breeze that broke the howling walls of Decarabian.

sources.title: Amos' Bow Weapon Lore
sources.quote: Even at the very moment her arrow pierced his heart, the fierce winds did not diminish her longing for true freedom.

title: The Fall of Khaenri'ah & Global Abyssal Incursion
summary: Khaenri'ah is annihilated by Abyssal calamity and Celestia's judgment, unleashing dark beasts across all seven nations.
description: Five centuries ago, the godless underground dynasty of Khaenri'ah collapsed. The alchemist Rhinedottir's 'Art of Khemia' broke containment, opening abyssal rifts that poured horrific monsters (such as the dragon Durin, rifthounds, and shadowy husks) across Teyvat. Celestia summoned the Seven Archons to Khaenri'ah. The nation was wiped off the map, its pureblood citizens cursed with immortality, and half-bloods transformed into hilichurls.

title: Sacrifices of the Archons (Makoto, Egeria & Rukkhadevata)
dateDisplay: 500 Years Ago • Aftermath of the Cataclysm
summary: Three Archons perish during the Cataclysm, altering the divine leadership of Inazuma, Fontaine, and Sumeru forever.
description: The toll of the Cataclysm was catastrophic for the Seven. Raiden Makoto traveled secretly to Khaenri'ah and perished in Ei's arms, leaving Ei to forge the Raiden Shogun puppet. In the desert of Tunigi Hollow, Egeria (Hydro Archon) died containing the abyss, her body transforming into the Amrita nectar. In Sumeru, Greater Lord Rukkhadevata sacrificed her physical form to purge the forbidden knowledge invading the Irminsul tree, plucking the purest branch to create Nahida.

title: The Outlander Awakens: Starfell Valley
summary: Having slept for five centuries following their separation from their twin, the Traveler awakens on Starfell Beach and fishes up Paimon.
description: Separated from their sibling by the Sustainer of Heavenly Principles during their attempted escape from Khaenri'ah's destruction, the Traveler was sealed in cubes of crimson light for 500 years. Awakening on a secluded beach in Mondstadt's Starfell Valley, the Traveler rescues a floating companion named Paimon from drowning. Together, they set forth on a journey across the Seven Nations to find the Seven Archons and reunite with their lost sibling.
